baseline.name: Search every suffix for the first eligible discount
baseline.approach: For each price, scan later prices until the first value <= it is found.
baseline.space: O(1) auxiliary for an in-place baseline

archived.name: Monotonic pending-discount stack
archived.time: O(n) amortized, where n=pricesSize; each index enters and leaves the stack at most once
archived.space: O(n) auxiliary stack; the returned pointer aliases the existing input array

why: Pending indices share a forward scan, and each is resolved only once when its first qualifying price arrives.
quantitative_comparison: Strictly increasing prices make the baseline perform n(n-1)/2 suffix comparisons. The archive pushes n indices and pops at most n, producing amortized linear work. These bounds do not supply a stopwatch speed factor.
tradeoffs: Adds O(n) stack memory and mutates/returns the original array, rather than allocating an independent result. The generic malloc-return comment must not be treated as an ownership guarantee.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
